title: Power (ক্ষমতা)
placement: Book page 120, topic 4.7: ক্ষমতা (Power). Next to the definition P = W/t, the unit box (W, ওয়াট; [P] = ML²T⁻³) and the paragraph on 1 W = 1 J each second, the 100 W bulb and the 1000 MW power plant.
description: Interactive 3D figure for textbook topic 4.7 (ক্ষমতা, Power), page 120. A sunny Bangladeshi house and courtyard: two electric pumps (a small blue one and a big red one) lift water from the underground tank through white PVC pipes into two see-through tanks on the roof, h = 3 m up, with a stopwatch beside each tank. Same work: both lift 500 kg (W = mgh = 14,700 J); the big pump fills its tank in 15 s, the small one in 30 s, so P = W/t = 980 W against 490 W, worked out live in a small W ÷ t = P table. Same time: both run 15 s and the big pump lifts twice the water, twice the work. The book's 100 W bulb over the door uses 100 J each second (1 W = 1 J/s), next to the book's 1000 MW power plant (1000 × 10⁶ J each second). Ideal pumps (no energy lost, efficiency is 4.8), time shown 3 times faster and said so. Five tap questions: a pump's power from the picture, same time, the bulb's energy, what a watt means, the power plant. The house, pumps, pipes and tanks export as GLB in metres. Offline, in Bangla and English.
